onb.provider.body: The Brainstorming Agent and Editor Agent run on an AI model you bring. OpenRouter gives one key for many models; you pay the provider directly, usually cents per video.
onb.provider.title: Connect an AI provider
onb.tour.body: We open a sample project and point at the six things you will use most. You can re-run it any time from Help.
onb.tour.title: Take the two-minute tour?
onb.welcome.body: Turn your clips into a polished motion video: pick looks, describe what you want, and export. Setup takes about three minutes.
onb.welcome.footnote: Everything runs on this PC. The internet is used only for the AI models you connect.
onb.welcome.title: Welcome to Expertmotion
tour.1.body: Home is text, Design is looks, Tools is generators. The left panel changes with each.
tour.1.title: Three places to work
tour.10.body: Export checks disk, memory and size first, then renders on this PC with progress and cancel. Your file lands in the project's output folder.
tour.10.title: Export when you are ready
tour.2.body: Drop clips, images and audio here. Number them with the badges, then press Insert to put them in the timeline. The sample's three clips are already in.
tour.2.title: Your assets live here
tour.3.body: Hover a card to try it on your own video in the player. Click to pick it.
tour.3.title: Preview before you pick
tour.3.try: Try it: click a card to pick it.
tour.4.body: Your pick appears here. Simple picks apply directly, with no AI involved. Pick another transition and the old one is struck through, not lost; Restore brings it back.
tour.4.title: Every pick is a receipt
tour.4.try: Try it: pick a second transition.
tour.5.body: Each lane is a track: video, overlay, text, captions, audio. Click any element to inspect it; your next picks then apply to it.
tour.5.title: Everything on the timeline
tour.5.try: Try it: click an element on the timeline.
tour.6.body: The Brainstorming Agent helps with ideas and structure. It never changes your video; it proposes, and you decide what to send on. Try: "judul pembuka yang energik".
tour.6.noprovider: Connect a provider from the Model Bar to try this.
tour.6.title: Think out loud here
tour.7.body: The Editor Agent turns requests into a plan: steps, what will change, and any risks. Read it, add a note if you like, then press Execute. Only then does the video change, and you can undo it.
tour.7.sample.label: Example plan
tour.7.sample.note: Connect a provider to see a real plan for your video.
tour.7.sample.plan: Add title 'Kafe Senja' 0–3 s · Rise motion
tour.7.title: Nothing changes until Execute
tour.8.body: Pick the platform shape (width:height) and resolution; the exact pixels are shown. Performance profiles change how much of your PC is used, never the video itself.
tour.8.title: Shape, size, speed
tour.9.body: Switch this on and Expertmotion makes no internet connections at all: agents pause, downloads pause, editing and export keep working. A banner reminds you while it is on.
tour.9.private.on: Switch it off to keep using the agents in this tour.
tour.9.title: Private Mode
tour.done.body: That is the whole loop: insert, pick, describe, Execute, export. Help ▸ Tour brings this back any time.
tour.done.title: Tour complete
tour.end.confirm: End the tour? You can re-run it from Help.
tour.preparing.failed: The sample project could not be prepared. You can take the tour on this project instead.
tour.rerun.title: Re-run the tour on this project or the sample?
tour.title: Tour
